name: Export modal validates Pure-TS ISOBMFF Fast-Start MP4 muxer configuration and Godot/Unity game engine sprite sheet packing
description: Validates opening the Export modal in the studio workspace, switching between isolated export tabs, inspecting the MP4 Video tab with Pure-TypeScript ISOBMFF progressive download Fast-Start container settings and WebCodecs H.264 profiles, configuring the Sprite Sheet tab with horizontal, vertical, and grid matrix layouts, and inspecting Godot 4 and Unity engine metadata generation.

planSteps.description: Click the Export button in the top navigation bar
Verify the Export modal opens displaying the format category tabs along the top of the dialog
Click the 'MP4 Video' format tab in the export navigation bar
Verify the MP4 export tab is displayed with resolution scale, frame rate, and WebCodecs H.264 Fast-Start notices
Click the 'Sprite Sheet' format tab in the export navigation bar
Verify the Sprite Sheet panel is displayed with Layout arrangement options and Game Engine metadata checkboxes
Click the 'Grid' layout mode button to arrange frames in a 2D matrix
Verify the column count input appears and the dimensions readout calculates grid dimensions
Click the close button in the top right corner of the export modal
Verify the Export modal dismisses and keyboard focus restores to the studio canvas workspace
